notes.title: June 2024 Update - Graphics Update and Balance Changes
notes.notes:
The June 2024 Update is one of our bigger updates! The latest build will feature these new changes!

[h1]Graphic Update[/h1]

We've updated the game's graphics to give our beloved Arbiters greater fidelity and cleaner look! 

Check out the screenshots below for a few examples:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/4e0ee37a07921364da4e743ed165d2c7f0714ca2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/edc9e457e56188bcfd5bd54aa15fd6902209ad3e.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/26960d6dd071e6703646761f6e197aaaba206b2f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/5998f786c19728343978845c692bf01fb0bb8507.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/1929d4113b1e5bc4c22e43ad224b339dc1457e86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/c10fbb6c3043046d165d431b1ea47dbf03b510d4.png[/img][/url]

You can also check these out for yourself by loading the latest demo!

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]

There have been some balance changes in preparation for the coming tournament.

[b]Hand-held Grenade Launcher[/b]
Damage reduced to 60 from 70
Effective Range reduced to 25 from 30
bullet speed reduced to 30 from 50

[b]Hand-held Gatling Gun[/b]
Bullet speed increased to 80 from 70
Fire Speed slightly increased

[b]Hand-held Submachinegun[/b]
Bullet speed increased to 50 from 35

[b]Plasma Slicer[/b]
Damage increased to 100 from 60

[b]Back-mounted Mortar[/b]
Damage increased to 90 from 80

[b]Back-mounted Homing Missiles[/b]
Cooldown reduced to 8 from 10s

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Several bugs were fixed in this patch:
1. Online Lobby Game Flow was streamlined to deal with disconnect issues.
2. Local Couch Play issues were fixed.
3. Fixed a visual bug for VS Screen in Arcade with Arbiters facing Backwards 

[h1]June 2024 Custom Palette Winner - Providence Blue[/b]

The winner of our Custom Palette contest is Octahedrone from our discord community. The winning entry "Providence Blue" has been added as an unlockable palette!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/23880e5c486aee65c6b756110a2d452747edc92d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/630b8511cfcc830f8adef00a3959df3380331053.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Monthly Tournament - June 29th[/h1]

Once again we'll be having a monthly online tournament open to all players on June 29, Saturday 5PM UTC+8!

Details and signups here: https://play.toornament.com/en_US/tournaments/7907285161889832960/

Join us in the Discord community for prizes and fun!

notes.title: May 2024 Monthly Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This is a small balance update. Bigger optimizations and features are still in the pipeline. Hopefully by June, we will see the improvements to the online experience. 

Until then, here are the updates to expect in the latest build.

[h2]New Feature[/h2]

[b]Time limit setup for Multiplayer Matches[/b]

Players can now set a time limit on their multiplayer matches. The player with more armor at the end of the time limit wins.

[h2]Bug Fixes/ Player Experience Adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lessen the tracking power of hand grenade launcher
[*] Equipped internals have been made visible in multiplayer lobby
[*] Fix combo multiplier on dagger and fist weapons' last hit
[*] Updated Weapon Icons for Customization Information

[h1]Mecha Blitz Monthly May[/h1]

Once again we are having our monthly community tournament this May 25th, with prizes now sponsored by RazerGold!  

[url=https://youtube.com/live/6-lgK9ALoMM?feature=share]WATCH IT HERE
[/url]

And make sure to join [url=https://discord.gg/M6gHw2uMfy]our community[/url] for future events!

notes.title: Open Beta Update 1, MBM March 2024 Results and Monthly Event Schedule
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Open Beta Update 1[/b][/h1]

The Open Beta Demo has been updated to match the tournament build we used during the first Mecha Blitz Monthlies Tournament for March 2024. 

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[b]Private Lobbies[/b]
You can now create private lobbies that will not appear in the public lobby list. Each lobby comes with an invite code that you can provide to your friends so you can invite them to your private room.

[b]Spectator Lists[/b]
A spectator list has been added to the lobby. The lobby owner can see the list of players spectating the game.

[b]Code Redemption[/b]
We added a new code redemption function to the main menu. Simply put in a code to get an in-game prize. These codes can be acquired from promotions, prizes and giveaways from our social media and community channels.

[url=https://discord.gg/M6gHw2uMfy][b]Join our Discord now to get this month's code! [/b][/url]

[i]Note: Codes disseminated during the beta test period will only be functional during the beta test period. Unless specified otherwise, such as tournament prize codes specified for the full launch of the game, these rewards will be reset along with all player data when the full game is released.[/i]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Post game screens player information corrected
[*] Lobby screen player information corrected
[*] Corrected information in Customize screen (weight/load information)
[/list]

[h1][b]Mecha Blitz Monthlies March 2024 has concluded[/b][/h1]

After an amazing series of battles, the one to emerge victorious is Mikusim!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/e42eaf1125a743dafcc9dd85cee541f9467ea795.png[/img]

The Mecha Blitz team would like to congratulate [b]Mikusim[/b] for an outstanding performance. He has won a code reward for the full game, the monthly discord title of Monthly Champion, and 500PHP worth of GCASH.

We'd also like to congratulate [b]Megarock[/b] and [b]MK[/b], who won third and second place, respectively. They have been given code rewards and monthly discord titles of Monthly Challenger.

You can view the full tournament on our[b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UuuOaXNpfAA]Official Youtube Channel[/url][/b] or on our partner, [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2078877242]Doby From The Replay's Twitch Channel[/url][/b]. 

You can view the brackets and tournament details [b][url=https://play.toornament.com/en_US/tournaments/7564111472760832000/]here[/url][/b].

Thank you to everyone who participated and supported us! Watch out for the next Mecha Blitz Monthly Tournament in April!

[h1][b]March Schedule and Plans Moving Forward[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729091/4995b4161a6794c4f2fac184116ba3c8e195d323.png[/img]

Here are our scheduled events for the month of March and the first half of April. 

[b]Balance and Feature Update[/b]
After this update, we will have balance and bug fix updates in the second half and the end of March. 

The balance update in the third week of March will be a tweaking of weapon and armor numerical values,  such as cooldown, damage, ammo count, etc

Whereas the april update will be a general bug fix and the addition of 'Tournament Mode', a PVP option that sets all players' weapons and armor stats to their base values. These updates will have a corresponding Extreme Exhibition Episode to cover their details.

[b]Mecha Blitz Monthlies April 2024[/b]
The next Mecha Blitz Monthlies Tournament is set for April 13, 2024. It will use the April 6 Open Demo Build and the new Tournament Mode setting.

The other details will be announced on our social media and community channels, so [b][url=https://linktr.ee/MechaBlitz]follow us![/url][/b]!
